answer: Random beacon audit with a compute heartbeat stops bulk fakes. Each epoch a public beacon picks 5% of agents; each must solve a puzzle within 60 seconds, like a lantern flashing through a gale: one real machine answers once, but a thousand clones on one box cannot. Each audit costs 10 credits, so 100 fakes cost 1,000 credits per sweep against a 5,000 pool. Honest agents pay one heartbeat, keep their share undiluted, and stay clear as crystal.
